legend.0: Different defects: fixing the defect `a` describes would leave the defect `b` describes unfixed, even when both sit in the same code.
legend.1: The same underlying defect, but `b` narrows it, re-scopes which instances or inputs it covers, or reports it at a different place. Not a different defect in adjacent code.
legend.2: The same defect restated in different words: fixing one fixes the other.
